summary.text: 8 leases in June at $1,964 average cost per lease. 94.3% leased, with 16 signed residents moving in; 23 move-outs and 11 move-ins put net move-ins at −12. Next month we're reconciling Google Ads spend and conversion tracking before renewal and improving where Zillow visitors land.

occupancy.label: Occupancy
occupancy.takeaway: 94.3% leased and 89.0% occupied, with 16 signed residents moving in; net move-ins were −12.
occupancy.note: Leased and occupied are month-end readings on 299 units. Hyly's daily average for the month reads 93.59% on a different unit count, so it isn't directly comparable. Residents on notice aren't in the data before July 27, 2026, so exposure and future leases for this month may read low.

funnel.label: Leasing funnel
funnel.takeaway: 92 leads became 8 leases; lead to lease took 32.8 days.
funnel.note: Counts are June activity at each step, not one group of prospects followed through, and each rate compares a step with the step before it. The longest step was application to lease at 17.8 days, 54% of the cycle. Days are Hyly's step velocity; we're confirming whether that's a median or an average.

spend.label: Spend and leases
spend.takeaway: $15,715 across 3 vendors; Zillow had the lowest cost per lead at $313.
spend.note: Leads and leases here use each lead's first source (the vendor basis). Most paid visitors reach the property website before they inquire, so the website carries the first-touch lease credit; Where leads came from shows the paid sources' part earlier in the journey.

attribution.label: Where leads came from
attribution.takeaway: Property website was the first source for 53 of 92 new leads; 477 prospects were influenced across all touches.
attribution.note: First touch credits each lead to the source that brought it in. Influenced counts a prospect once for every source that touched it, so the columns add up to more than the prospect total. The Hyly assistant played a part in 9 of the 19 tours. By medium, 72.8% of new leads were organic and 1.1% were tagged paid search.

website.label: Website
website.takeaway: 2,566 sessions from 1,818 users, 55.0% engaged; floor plan B2 drew the most views per user (3.74).
website.note: Average engagement time was 55 seconds. Zillow sent 352 sessions with an 85.5% bounce rate and 0 conversions; we're reviewing where those visitors land. The floor plans page was viewed 1,568 times.

paid_search.label: Paid search
paid_search.takeaway: 5.20% click-through rate, above the 3–5% benchmark; we're aligning 73 ad conversions with the 7 leads in the CRM.
paid_search.note: Google Ads recorded 73 conversions, and 7 leads with Google Ads as their first source reached the CRM, with 0 leases. We're aligning the conversion definition with CRM leads before the next budget cycle.

reputation.label: Reputation
reputation.takeaway: Google 4.3 and Apartments.com 4.0, both at or above the 4.0 target; Yelp and Facebook aren't connected yet.

listings.label: Listings
listings.note: Placement tiers and costs aren't in the listing feed yet.

actions.title: Reconcile Google Ads spend and conversion tracking before renewal
actions.detail: The spend manager shows $12,140 and the ad platform $5,269. The platform recorded 73 conversions, and 7 leads reached the CRM. We'll align both before the next budget cycle.

actions.title: Keep Zillow in the plan and improve where its visitors land
actions.detail: Zillow had the lowest cost per lead at $313. Its 352 website sessions had an 85.5% bounce rate, so we're testing a landing page that matches the listing.

actions.title: Bring retention into next month's plan
actions.detail: 23 move-outs and 11 move-ins put net move-ins at −12. We'll bring renewal and resident-retention ideas to the next owner call.

actions.title: Shorten the time from application to lease
actions.detail: Application to lease took 17.8 of the 32.8 days from lead to lease. Schedule to tour runs at 2.0 days, so we'll review the approval steps with the leasing team.

actions.title: Review floor plan B2 pricing and availability against demand
actions.detail: Floor plan B2 drew 3.74 views per user, the most of any plan on the site.

actions_takeaway: 5 steps for next month, starting with reconcile Google Ads spend and conversion tracking before renewal.

discrepancies.text: Google Ads spend differs between the spend manager ($12,140) and the ad platform ($5,269); we're reconciling before renewal.
Lead counts depend on the basis: Google Ads shows 7 leads by vendor and 14 by spend source; Zillow shows 6 leads by vendor and 12 by spend source. This report uses the vendor basis.
Google Ads recorded 73 conversions, while 7 leads list Google Ads as their first source; we're aligning the conversion definition.
1 new lead is tagged paid search by medium, while 7 list Google Ads as their source; we're reviewing the tags.
Occupied (88.96%) is the month-end reading on 299 units; Hyly's daily average (93.59%) uses a different unit count.

gaps.reason: Days per step are Hyly's velocity figures; the metric library doesn't define them yet, so whether they're medians or averages is unconfirmed.
No first-touch lead source maps to the Paid social (Meta) budget, so its leads and leases aren't attributed.
Placement tier and cost aren't in the listing feed yet. Chat, tour and application lead types aren't populated, so they're left out rather than shown as zero.
Reputation scores come from the June report design; the lake export doesn't carry them, so they aren't reconciled.
June 1–5, 2026 includes a historical backfill in one Hyly feed (ADR 0022). Lead counts here follow Hyly's created-lead definition; compare June with other months with care.

sources_note: 1–30 June 2026 · Hyly data lake (occupancy, leasing and lead sources) · Hyly data-lake dashboard export (spend manager, multi-touch attribution, website and Google Ads) · reputation scores from the June report · RPM benchmarks
